name: Release room
description: Changes -> build -> tests -> release notes -> deployment approval. Produces versioned release artifacts and an approval trail.

steps.title: Collect changes for {{version}}
steps.acceptance: Every item references a commit or PR.
steps.instructions: List the changes since the last release for {{version}} using git log. Cite commits.

steps.title: Build {{version}}
steps.acceptance: Build command executed with captured output.
steps.instructions: Run the build for {{version}} and record output and artifact locations.

steps.title: Test {{version}}
steps.instructions: Run the full test suite for {{version}} and record results.

steps.title: Release notes for {{version}}
steps.acceptance: Notes match the change list; no invented items.
steps.instructions: Write release notes for {{version}} from the change list and test results.

steps.title: Deployment approval for {{version}}
steps.acceptance: Explicit approve/deny recorded by a person; no automatic deployment.
steps.instructions: Review build, tests, and notes for {{version}}. Record the decision. Deployment itself requires a separate approved action.
